title: Passing Implicit Thread-Local State instead of Thread-Safe Handlers
pattern: Relying on implicit global static variables or unsafe thread-local variables to carry critical execution context.
why_bad: It causes race conditions, premature disposal, and memory unsafety in concurrent execution contexts. The compiler cannot guarantee that the active instance is safe across threads.
detection: Usage of `static mut` or unsafe global variables to store runtime task context.
counterexample:
Thread-safe reference-counted state passed explicitly:
```rust
let transaction = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Transaction::new()));
```
